content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processors like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital creators face significant challenges in selling their products. The inability to process payments effectively stifles creativity and limits income potential. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store powered by no-KYC payments provides creators with a robust alternative to traditional payment methods that often impose hefty fees and restrictions. By utilizing a decentralized payment system like NOWPayments, creators can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal 0.5% fee. This is a stark contrast to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale. For a creator selling a $97 product, the difference in fees can mean retaining an additional $921 each month at 100 sales, which can significantly impact a creator's bottom line.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC digital product store relies on various integrated components that work seamlessly together. Utilizing tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing creates an efficient and cost-effective digital commerce stack. This combination enables automatic payment verification and instant product delivery, ensuring that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation. Not only does this system eliminate the need for a middleman, but it also empowers creators by providing full ownership of their data and sales.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who sell products such as ebooks, courses, templates, and software in regions where payment platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted. It's for those who are tired of depending on companies that impose high fees and take a large cut of their earnings. By leveraging this no-KYC payment architecture, creators can gain autonomy over their businesses, enhance their revenue potential, and cater to a global audience without the constraints imposed by traditional payment systems.
No more 10% fees — keep 99.5% of your sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of a no-KYC digital product store include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provide a free and reliable platform for your website. For backend operations, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order management and product delivery efficiently. NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions, allowing for seamless payment experiences without the need for KYC requirements. Together, these elements form a cohesive stack that enables creators to launch and operate their stores independently, without reliance on conventional payment processors.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your digital product store with no-KYC payments, start by selecting a hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage transactions. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, ensuring you can accept payments without KYC barriers. Load your products into the system and configure automatic delivery. For those looking for comprehensive guidance, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the blueprints and templates necessary for a successful launch.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a no-KYC payment processor like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrencies directly, ensuring you retain more of your profits. A decentralized approach also gives you full control over your sales and customer data, leading to greater independence as a creator.
Instant product delivery means happier customers.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Implement backend functionality using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order management. 3. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. 4. Upload your digital products to your store. 5. Configure automatic delivery for customers upon payment confirmation. 6. Test the entire system to ensure smooth operations. 7. Launch your store and begin promoting your products to your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online using a no-KYC payment processor like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept payments in cryptocurrencies directly, bypassing traditional payment platforms entirely. Integrate this solution with a hosting service to create a complete e-commerce setup.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without significant platform fees is to utilize a decentralized payment solution like NOWPayments. This minimizes transaction costs, allowing you to retain more revenue from each sale compared to platforms that charge high fees.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip by setting up your own digital store using a combination of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments for payment processing.
What are the benefits of using crypto for payments?

Using cryptocurrency for payments offers numerous benefits, including lower transaction fees, no KYC requirements, and immediate payment confirmation. This allows for a smoother customer experience and greater financial autonomy for creators.
How secure is this payment method?

No-KYC payment methods like NOWPayments are secure as they use blockchain technology to verify transactions. This reduces the risk of fraud and provides a transparent way to manage payments without compromising customer data.
Full data ownership empowers your business decisions.
